name: Stripe
look: Gradient-mesh hero over a white canvas, weight-300 display type, a single indigo pill CTA.

fonts.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

hero.title: Financial infrastructure to grow your revenue
hero.sub: Join millions of companies that use Ledgerline to accept payments, send payouts, and manage their businesses online.

features.title: Everything you need to move money
features.sub: A unified platform for online and in-person payments, billing, marketplaces and financial reporting.

items.title: Payments
items.body: Accept cards, wallets and local methods in 135 currencies with a single integration and one reconciliation model.

items.title: Billing
items.body: Recurring subscriptions, usage-based pricing, proration and dunning without a billing engine of your own.

items.title: Connect
items.body: Onboard sellers, split payments and handle payouts across a marketplace with compliance built in.

items.title: Radar
items.body: Machine-learned fraud scoring trained on network-wide signal, tunable with rules you write yourself.

items.title: Reporting
items.body: Every transaction reconciled to the cent, exportable to your ledger with tabular figures throughout.

items.title: Developer tools
items.body: Idempotent APIs, typed SDKs in nine languages, and a test mode that mirrors production exactly.

showcases.title: A checkout that converts
showcases.body: A prebuilt, hosted payment page localised into 30 languages and optimised continuously against network-wide conversion data. One redirect, no PCI scope.
points: Apple Pay, Google Pay and Link out of the box
Adaptive 3D Secure that only steps up when it lifts authorisation
Address and card autofill across the network

showcases.title: Reconciliation that actually reconciles
showcases.body: Every balance transaction, fee and refund is exposed as a queryable row. Close the month against the ledger rather than against a dashboard screenshot.
points: Tabular figures on every numeric cell
Revenue recognition on the accrual basis

metric_lead: Measured across the platform in the last twelve months

gallery.title: Built for developers
gallery.sub: Documentation, sandboxes and reference implementations for every surface of the platform.

testimonial.quote: We replaced four vendors and a reconciliation spreadsheet with one integration. The finance team closed the month two days early for the first time in the company's history.
testimonial.name: Daniel Okafor

pricing.title: Integrated per-transaction pricing
pricing.sub: No setup fees, monthly fees, or hidden fees. Only pay for what you use.

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.desc: Everything you need to accept payments online.

items.q: Are there any setup or monthly fees?
items.a: No. Integrated pricing is purely per successful transaction, so an account that processes nothing in a month is charged nothing that month.

items.q: How are refunds and disputes handled?
items.a: Refunding a charge returns the full amount to the customer; the original processing fee is not returned. Disputes carry a separate fee that is reversed automatically when the dispute is resolved in your favour.
Yes, on Scale and Enterprise. Interchange, scheme fees and the margin are itemised separately on every balance transaction.
On a rolling two-day schedule by default, configurable to daily, weekly or monthly, with instant payouts available to supported debit cards.

cta.title: Start building today
cta.sub: Create an account and begin taking live payments in minutes, or talk to us about a bespoke package.

footer.tagline: Financial infrastructure for the internet economy.

notes: The gradient mesh belongs in the upper third of the page only — cream, orange, lavender, indigo and ruby washed horizontally. It never repeats lower down.
Exactly one filled indigo pill per view. Every other action is a ghost link with a chevron.
Display type sits at weight 300 with negative tracking; the lightness is the brand, so resist bolding headlines.
Any cell containing money uses tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums). This is the quiet financial-data signal.
Cream bands break long white stretches without introducing a new hue.
